_meta.description: FinOps best-practice rules evaluated over `infracost breakdown --format json` by openbank-infra/scripts/cloud-finops-collect.py (ADR-0316). Every finding row in ClickHouse carries `rules_version`, so a change to this file is visible as a step in the compliance trend rather than read as the estate improving or regressing.
_meta.savings_note: est_saving_ratio is a deliberately conservative fraction of the matched cost component's monthly cost, from AWS list-price deltas (gp2->gp3 is ~20% per GB; Graviton is ~20% per vCPU-hour; current-gen x86 over previous-gen is ~10%). They are estimates for ranking, not quotes.
_meta.refresh: Edit in a PR; bump `version`. The unit tests in openbank-infra/scripts/cloud_finops_collect_test.py hold a known-positive and a known-negative fixture for every rule.

ebs-gp2-to-gp3.description: gp2 EBS/RDS storage: gp3 is cheaper per GB with a higher baseline IOPS.

previous-generation-instance.description: Previous-generation instance family: current generation is cheaper per unit of work.

non-graviton-instance.description: x86 instance family with a Graviton (arm64) equivalent.

missing-required-tags.description: Taggable resource missing a required cost-allocation tag (see required_tags).

nat-gateway-per-az.description: More than one managed NAT Gateway in one project: each carries a fixed hourly charge; a single NAT (or fck-nat, ADR-0058) serves a non-production environment.
